library(tidyverse)

# Overview

`run-daily-forecast.R` runs once a day, predicts RM 8.5 daily max temperature
and 7DADM at 1-, 3-, and 7-day lead times, and appends the predictions to
`output/instream-forecast-log.csv`. This analysis focuses only on the
**7DADM** predictions.

Now that real RM 8.5 logger data exists, this analysis **re-runs the 7DADM RF
model** for every historical forecast date where a real RM 8.5 lag is
available, using:

1. The **cached NWS forecast log** (`output/nws-forecasts-log.csv`) for
   air temperature / cloud cover — those can't be re-fetched after the fact,
   so we reuse exactly what was forecast at the time.
2. A **fresh OWRD pull** of Camp Polk flow and temperature for the correct
   historical date range (not just "today", as the operational script does).
3. The **real RM 8.5 observation** from the day before each forecast run,
   in place of the 2025 stand-in.

The model itself is the **lead-aware design** from `rm85-rf-lead-aware.Rmd`
(`rm85_rf_7dadm_lead_aware_lead*.rds`): one random forest per lead (1
through 7) sharing a single feature set — Camp Polk's current conditions and
trend, the NWS forecast trajectory across day +1 through +7 from the run
date, seasonal timing, and RM 8.5's own previous-day 7DADM (`dadm_m1`) —
rather than the single-day snapshot the previously deployed model used.
That analysis found the model reallocates trust away from `dadm_m1` toward
seasonal timing and Camp Polk's current flow as lead grows, on its own.

The resulting predictions are then compared against the real RM 8.5
observations to measure actual forecast skill: bias, MAE, RMSE, and
threshold-exceedance accuracy — mirroring the threshold used operationally
in `run-daily-forecast.R`.

```{r config}
# Same threshold/station used in analysis/run-daily-forecast.R
threshold_7dadm <- 20.0
owrd_station    <- "14076100"  # Camp Polk
lead_days_vec   <- c(1:7)
trend_window    <- 5           # must match trend_window in rm85-rf-lead-aware.Rmd

# Shared color scale for lead_days plots below (blue = short lead, red = long lead)
lead_colors <- setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#185FA5", "#4E9F50", "#C93312"))(length(lead_days_vec)),
                        as.character(lead_days_vec))
```

# Read in data

```{r}
# Cached NWS forecast pulls — reused as-is rather than re-fetched, since past
# forecasts can't be re-requested from the NWS API.
nws_cached <- read_csv(here("output", "nws-forecasts-log.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    run_date      = as.Date(run_date),
    forecast_date = as.Date(forecast_date)
  )

rm_8_5_new <- readxl::read_xlsx(here("data-raw", "data-raw", "WC85 Rimrock bottom 2026-07-01 13_01_25 PDT.xlsx")) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  glimpse()
```

# Build the RM 8.5 observed daily series

Aggregate the raw logger readings to daily statistics, the same way
`rm_8_5_historical` is structured, so the two are directly comparable.

```{r}
rm_8_5 <- rm_8_5_new |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(lubridate::floor_date(date_time_pdt, "1 day"))) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(
    mean   = mean(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    max    = max(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE),
    min    = min(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    `7DADM` = zoo::rollapply(max, width = 7, FUN = mean, fill = NA, align = "right")
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean:min, `7DADM`), values_to = "temperature", names_to = "statistic") |>
  glimpse()
```

```{r}
ggplot() + 
  geom_line(data = rm_8_5_new, aes(x = date_time_pdt, y = temperature_c)) +
  geom_line(data = rm_8_5 |> filter(statistic == "7DADM"), aes(x = date, y = temperature)) +
  theme_minimal()
  
```

```{r}
rm_8_5_wide <- rm_8_5 |>
  filter(statistic == "7DADM") |>
  select(date, actual_7dadm_C = temperature)
```

# Re-running the model with real inputs

## Which forecast runs can be re-hindcast

A forecast run can only be re-hindcast if the real RM 8.5 observation from
the day before that run (its lag input) exists.

```{r hindcast-run-dates}
hindcast_run_dates <- nws_cached |>
  distinct(run_date) |>
  filter((run_date - 1) %in% rm_8_5_wide$date) |>
  pull(run_date) |>
  sort()

cat(sprintf("Re-running %d forecast runs: %s to %s\n",
            length(hindcast_run_dates), min(hindcast_run_dates), max(hindcast_run_dates)))
```

## Fresh Camp Polk pull (flow & temperature)

Pull OWRD Camp Polk flow and temperature for the historical span these
forecast runs actually needed — `min(run_date) - 10` (enough lookback for a
7DADM) through `max(run_date)` — rather than the operational script's
"last 10 days from today".

```{r owrd-fresh-pull}
pull_start <- min(hindcast_run_dates) - 10
pull_end   <- max(hindcast_run_dates)

cat(sprintf("OWRD pull window: %s to %s\n", pull_start, pull_end))

cp_flow_raw <- get_owrd_hydro(owrd_station, pull_start, pull_end, "Instantaneous_Flow")
cp_tmax_raw <- get_owrd_hydro(owrd_station, pull_start, pull_end, "WTEMP15")

cp_flow <- cp_flow_raw |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(parse_date_time(record_date, orders = c("mdy", "mdy HM")))) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(cp_flow_mean = mean(instananteous_flow_cfs, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(date)

cp_tmax <- cp_tmax_raw |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(parse_date_time(record_date, orders = c("mdy", "mdy HM")))) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarise(cp_tmax = max(instantaneous_water_temp_c, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(date)

cp_7dadm <- cp_tmax |>
  mutate(cp_7dadm = zoo::rollmean(cp_tmax, k = 7, fill = NA, align = "right"))

cp_daily <- cp_flow |>
  left_join(cp_tmax, by = "date") |>
  left_join(select(cp_7dadm, date, cp_7dadm), by = "date")

cat(sprintf("Camp Polk daily series: %s to %s (%d days)\n",
            min(cp_daily$date), max(cp_daily$date), nrow(cp_daily)))
```

## Model inputs per run date & lead day

Same feature set as the lead-aware model in `rm85-rf-lead-aware.Rmd`: Camp
Polk's current conditions and trend, the NWS forecast trajectory at every
day from +1 to +7 from the run date (not a single-day snapshot), and RM
8.5's own previous-day 7DADM — sourced here from the fresh Camp Polk pull,
the cached NWS log, and the real RM 8.5 lag instead of live pulls and the
2025 stand-in. Unlike the historical archive used to *train* the model,
`nws_cached` is real day-by-day NWS output pulled live each day, so all 7
trajectory points here are genuine forecasts, not a proxy.

```{r build-hindcast-inputs}
safe1 <- function(x) if (length(x) == 0) NA_real_ else x

# Aggregate one cached NWS variable to a single day, the same way
# daily_nws() does in run-daily-forecast.R (max/min/mean per variable).
nws_daily <- function(var, target_date, agg_fn, run_date_val) {
  vals <- nws_cached |>
    filter(run_date == run_date_val, variable == var, forecast_date == target_date) |>
    pull(value)
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  agg_fn(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
}

build_hindcast_row <- function(run_date_val, k) {
  fdate <- run_date_val + k

  cp_today  <- cp_daily |> filter(date == run_date_val)
  cp_yest   <- cp_daily |> filter(date == run_date_val - 1)
  cp_trendw <- cp_daily |> filter(date == run_date_val - trend_window)
  lag_row   <- rm_8_5_wide |> filter(date == run_date_val - 1)

  cp_flow_m1_val  <- safe1(cp_yest$cp_flow_mean)
  cp_7dadm_m1_val <- safe1(cp_yest$cp_7dadm)

  traj <- map(1:7, function(d) {
    tibble(
      !!paste0("air_max_d", d) := nws_daily("maxTemperature", run_date_val + d, max,  run_date_val),
      !!paste0("air_min_d", d) := nws_daily("minTemperature", run_date_val + d, min,  run_date_val),
      !!paste0("cloud_d",   d) := nws_daily("skyCover",       run_date_val + d, mean, run_date_val)
    )
  }) |> bind_cols()

  bind_cols(
    tibble(
      run_date       = run_date_val,
      forecast_date  = fdate,
      lead_days      = k,
      cp_flow_mean   = safe1(cp_today$cp_flow_mean),
      cp_7dadm       = safe1(cp_today$cp_7dadm),
      cp_flow_trend  = (cp_flow_m1_val  - safe1(cp_trendw$cp_flow_mean)) / (trend_window - 1),
      cp_7dadm_trend = (cp_7dadm_m1_val - safe1(cp_trendw$cp_7dadm))     / (trend_window - 1),
      Julian         = yday(fdate)
    ),
    traj,
    tibble(dadm_m1 = safe1(lag_row$actual_7dadm_C))
  )
}

hindcast_grid   <- expand_grid(run_date = hindcast_run_dates, lead_days = lead_days_vec)
hindcast_inputs <- map2_dfr(hindcast_grid$run_date, hindcast_grid$lead_days, build_hindcast_row)

cat(sprintf("Hindcast input rows: %d\n", nrow(hindcast_inputs)))
```

## Predict

Load each lead day's saved lead-aware RF model once and predict across all
matching rows.

```{r hindcast-predict}
predict_for_lead <- function(k) {
  rf_7dadm <- readRDS(here("output", paste0("rm85_rf_7dadm_lead_aware_lead", k, ".rds")))

  rows <- hindcast_inputs |> filter(lead_days == k)

  feat_7dadm_x <- rows |> select(cp_flow_mean, cp_7dadm, cp_flow_trend, cp_7dadm_trend, Julian,
                                  paste0("air_max_d", 1:7), paste0("air_min_d", 1:7), paste0("cloud_d", 1:7),
                                  dadm_m1)

  dadm_ok <- complete.cases(feat_7dadm_x)

  rows$pred_7dadm_C <- NA_real_
  if (any(dadm_ok)) rows$pred_7dadm_C[dadm_ok] <- round(predict(rf_7dadm, feat_7dadm_x[dadm_ok, ]), 2)

  rows |> select(run_date, forecast_date, lead_days, pred_7dadm_C)
}

hindcast_results <- map_dfr(lead_days_vec, predict_for_lead)

cat(sprintf("Re-run predictions: %d rows (%d complete 7DADM)\n",
            nrow(hindcast_results),
            sum(!is.na(hindcast_results$pred_7dadm_C))))
```

# Overlap between forecasts and observed data

Performance can only be evaluated where a re-run prediction and a real
observation both exist for the same `forecast_date`.

```{r overlap-window}
obs_range <- range(rm_8_5_wide$date, na.rm = TRUE)
fc_range  <- range(hindcast_results$forecast_date, na.rm = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("RM 8.5 observed data:      %s to %s\n", obs_range[1], obs_range[2]))
cat(sprintf("Re-run forecast_dates:     %s to %s\n", fc_range[1], fc_range[2]))
```

```{r join-forecasts-actuals}
forecast_eval <- hindcast_results |>
  inner_join(rm_8_5_wide, by = c("forecast_date" = "date")) |>
  filter(!is.na(actual_7dadm_C)) |>
  mutate(
    dadm_error  = pred_7dadm_C - actual_7dadm_C,
    lead_days   = factor(lead_days, levels = lead_days_vec)
  )

cat(sprintf("Forecast/observation pairs available for evaluation: %d\n", nrow(forecast_eval)))

forecast_eval |>
  arrange(forecast_date, lead_days) |>
  kable(digits = 2)
```

# Error metrics by lead day

```{r error-metrics}
metrics_by_lead <- forecast_eval |>
  group_by(lead_days) |>
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    dadm_bias      = mean(dadm_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    dadm_mae       = mean(abs(dadm_error), na.rm = TRUE),
    dadm_rmse      = sqrt(mean(dadm_error^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    dadm_cor       = cor(pred_7dadm_C, actual_7dadm_C, use = "complete.obs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

metrics_by_lead |>
  kable(digits = 2,
        col.names = c("Lead (days)", "n",
                      "7DADM bias", "7DADM MAE", "7DADM RMSE", "7DADM r"))
```

Positive bias means the model runs warm (over-predicts); negative bias means
it runs cold. MAE/RMSE are in °C.

# Threshold-exceedance performance

Beyond raw temperature error, the operational value of the forecast is
whether it correctly flags days that cross the HCP action threshold
(7DADM ≥ `r threshold_7dadm`°C).

```{r exceedance-confusion}
exceedance_eval <- forecast_eval |>
  mutate(
    pred_exceed_7dadm   = pred_7dadm_C   >= threshold_7dadm,
    actual_exceed_7dadm = actual_7dadm_C >= threshold_7dadm
  )

confusion_summary <- function(df, pred_col, actual_col) {
  df <- df |> filter(!is.na({{ pred_col }}), !is.na({{ actual_col }}))
  tp <- sum(df[[deparse(substitute(pred_col))]]  & df[[deparse(substitute(actual_col))]])
  tn <- sum(!df[[deparse(substitute(pred_col))]] & !df[[deparse(substitute(actual_col))]])
  fp <- sum(df[[deparse(substitute(pred_col))]]  & !df[[deparse(substitute(actual_col))]])
  fn <- sum(!df[[deparse(substitute(pred_col))]] & df[[deparse(substitute(actual_col))]])

  tibble(
    n           = nrow(df),
    accuracy    = (tp + tn) / nrow(df),
    sensitivity = if (tp + fn > 0) tp / (tp + fn) else NA_real_,
    specificity = if (tn + fp > 0) tn / (tn + fp) else NA_real_,
    precision   = if (tp + fp > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else NA_real_
  )
}

exceedance_by_lead <- exceedance_eval |>
  group_by(lead_days) |>
  group_modify(~ confusion_summary(.x, pred_exceed_7dadm, actual_exceed_7dadm)) |>
  ungroup()

exceedance_by_lead |>
  kable(digits = 2,
        col.names = c("Lead (days)", "n", "Accuracy", "Sensitivity", "Specificity", "Precision"))
```

# Predicted vs. observed

```{r scatter-pred-vs-actual, fig.height=4.5}
forecast_eval |>
  ggplot(aes(x = actual_7dadm_C, y = pred_7dadm_C, color = lead_days)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#666666") +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = lead_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "RM 8.5 7DADM forecast vs. observed",
    x = "Observed 7DADM (°C)", y = "Predicted 7DADM (°C)", color = "Lead (days)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Forecast vs. observed over time

```{r timeseries-pred-vs-actual, fig.height=4.5}
observed_7dadm <- rm_8_5_wide |>
  filter(date >= min(forecast_eval$forecast_date), date <= max(forecast_eval$forecast_date))

ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = observed_7dadm, aes(x = date, y = actual_7dadm_C), color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = forecast_eval, aes(x = forecast_date, y = pred_7dadm_C, color = lead_days), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = threshold_7dadm, linetype = "dotted", color = "#E24B4A") +
  scale_color_manual(values = lead_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "RM 8.5 7DADM observed (black line) vs. forecast (points, by lead day)",
    subtitle = "Dotted red line = HCP action threshold",
    x = NULL, y = "7DADM (°C)", color = "Lead (days)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Forecast error by lead day

```{r error-boxplots, fig.height=4.5}
forecast_eval |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lead_days, y = dadm_error, fill = lead_days)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#666666") +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = lead_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "7DADM forecast error (predicted − observed) by lead day",
    x = "Lead (days)", y = "Error (°C)", fill = "Lead (days)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
